candidates.change_summary: Change the final return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so successful calls return a different value.
Change require(_tos.length > 0) to require(_tos.length > 1) so a single-recipient call reverts instead of succeeding.
Change the loop bound from i<_tos.length to i<_tos.length-1 so the last recipient never receives a transfer (and length-1 underflows for empty arrays).
Change the transferred amount from v[i] to v[i]+1 so a different amount is transferred on each call.
Replace from with address(this) in the transferFrom call so tokens are pulled from the contract instead of the caller-supplied address.
Delete the require(_s) inside the loop so failed transferFrom calls no longer revert the transaction.
Change the return value from true to false so successful calls return false instead of true.
